uniprot.evidence_rule: UniProt INTERACTION comment, same-species, interactant one carries an isoform suffix (e.g. P21802-3)

intact.service: EBI IntAct web service, binary interactions, interactor species 9606
intact.use: Tier-H only: an 'untested' isoform with an exact isoform-level IntAct record for the same partner is moved out of the competitor set (role excluded_other_evidence)
intact.note: no negative-flagged records were returned for the 75 queried genes

cellchatdb_exclusion.use: Tier-E only: a paralog whose gene-level pair with the partner appears in CellChatDB v2 (any subunit accession) is excluded from the competitor set (role excluded_known_lr)

paralog_families: UniProt SIMILARITY comment 'Belongs to the ... family'; families with 2-12 sequence-bearing members
identity: Biopython PairwiseAligner global, BLOSUM62, open -11, extend -1, free end gaps; identity = identical aligned residues / alignment columns
contrast_rule: exactly one reference (the evidenced variant with most experiments) and >=1 competitor
build_code: interactive build (UniProt REST + IntAct connector); not shipped as a script. This frozen file is the pre-registered input.
